security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown, Korean text, documentation links, or server-side credential references rather than dangerous operations. The proxy receives location queries, while the CLI executes mutable npm code and recommends updates beyond this skill. No evidence found of embedded credential theft or malicious prompt injection in the reviewed files; remote package behavior remains outside this review.

remediation.issue: The default proxy receives search terms and potentially precise origin and destination coordinates.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the proxy operator, logging, and retention before location requests; offer a trusted HTTPS proxy and minimize sensitive coordinates.

remediation.issue: The bootstrap executes a mutable npm version range and treats remotely returned text as primary skill instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle reviewed instructions and pin an exact CLI version with verified integrity; require approval before external execution or adopting changed instructions.

remediation.issue: The maintenance command recommends updating every coding-agent skill installation, including unrelated tools.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the global update step from normal lookup instructions; require explicit approval and show affected installations before maintenance.

content.user_title: Find Korean Places and Estimate Driving Routes
content.value_statement: Finding Korean places and comparing driving options can require several API queries. This skill guides Kakao searches and route estimates through a proxy without a personal API key.
actual_capabilities: Search places by keyword with optional coordinates, radius, category filters, and distance sorting.
Find nearby places by Kakao category code and required center coordinates.
Convert coordinates into road addresses, parcel addresses, and administrative regions.
Request driving directions with up to five waypoints, alternative routes, route priorities, and avoidance options.
Summarize route distance, estimated duration, tolls, and taxi fare estimates from Kakao Mobility responses.
Explain documented proxy errors for invalid parameters, missing upstream configuration, quota limits, and network failures.
limitations: Directions cover driving only, not public transit, walking, or cycling.
Proxy caching, quotas, and service availability limit freshness and request volume.
The skill provides data lookups, not map rendering, reservations, payments, or automated driving.
The bootstrap requires external npm execution; the hosted proxy receives submitted searches and coordinates.

use_cases.title: Find Nearby Amenities
use_cases.description: Find cafes, pharmacies, or parking near a chosen location and compare returned distances and addresses.

use_cases.title: Compare Driving Options
use_cases.description: Estimate distance, travel time, tolls, and taxi fares for a personal trip with selected route preferences.

use_cases.title: Identify an Address from Coordinates
use_cases.description: Resolve a known coordinate into road, parcel, and administrative-region labels for a personal location note.

prompt_templates.title: Search for a Place
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Starbucks near Gangnam Station within 500 meters. Sort by distance and show returned names, addresses, phone numbers, and place links.

prompt_templates.title: Search by Category
prompt_templates.prompt: Find cafes within 300 meters of longitude 127.0276, latitude 37.4979 using category CE7. Show the five nearest returned places.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve Coordinates
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve longitude 127.0276, latitude 37.4979 into road and parcel addresses. Include legal and administrative districts when available, citing Kakao Local.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Driving Priorities
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare TIME and DISTANCE driving routes from 126.9706,37.5559 to 127.0276,37.4979, avoiding tolls. Report distance, duration, fares, source, and lookup time.

output_examples.input: Show the expected summary for a driving route from Seoul Station toward Gangnam.
output: Illustrative output only, not a live lookup.
Toll estimate: KRW 1,200. Taxi fare estimate: KRW 18,500.
Source: Kakao Mobility through k-skill-proxy. Actual results depend on the returned response and lookup time.

output_examples.input: What happens if the proxy operator has not configured the Kakao API key?
output: The proxy operator must configure its Kakao REST API key.
You do not need to provide a personal API key or reveal credentials.

best_practices: Review the external CLI version and affected installations before execution or updates.
Share only necessary coordinates with a trusted proxy, and verify longitude precedes latitude.
Include the source and lookup time, label estimates clearly, and keep requests within personal-use limits.
anti_patterns: Treating driving estimates as public transit directions or guaranteed arrival times.
Bulk crawling, database building, aggressive polling, or bypassing service access restrictions.
Providing plaintext credentials or approving unrelated global updates during a map lookup.

faq.question: Do I need a Kakao API key?
faq.answer: No personal key is required for the hosted proxy. The proxy operator configures the Kakao REST API key.

faq.question: Does this skill provide transit or walking routes?
faq.answer: No. Kakao Mobility directions here are for driving. The instructions refer transit requests to a separate skill.

faq.question: Can I convert coordinates into an address?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented routes return road and parcel addresses, plus administrative regions.

faq.question: Are travel times and fares guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. They are estimates from returned API data. Proxy caching and service limits can affect freshness.

faq.question: Where are my location queries sent?
faq.answer: Requests go to k-skill-proxy.nomadamas.org by default. You can configure KSKILL_PROXY_BASE_URL to use another trusted proxy.

faq.question: Does installation execute external software?
faq.answer: The documented bootstrap uses npx to run @nomadamas/k-skill@0. Review and pin external software before running it; the package is not bundled.
